<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.1939. Assuming this corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈267.1867 Da. A plausible molecular formula that matches this exact mass and is consistent with the observed isotopic pattern (≈20 % M+1 intensity, indicating ~18 carbons) is C₁₈H₁₉O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C18H19O2</final_answer>
